--- Free Sample: Down Direction Only ---

This is a free sample from my Medieval Citizens Vol.1 pack.
It contains the Farmer character, Down direction only:
- Idle animation (4 frames)
- Walk animation (8 frames)
- Work animation (pitchfork swing)
- 3 portraits (64x64 PNG, transparent background)

The full version with all 8 directions is available on itch:
